# Lending Desk

Handles short-term equipment loans for a university department.

## Rules

A borrower may not hold more than three items at once, so that scarce equipment
circulates. A loan must be returned within fourteen days of collection.

Any loan that is more than seven days overdue is escalated to the department
administrator. A borrower with an unpaid penalty cannot start a new loan.

## Operating notes

Nightly reconciliation runs at 02:00 and is not intended to be triggered by hand.
